mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate reduces the cost of capital for corporations, increasing equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS falls but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.0%, it signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST and RSAFS) indicate strong consumer demand, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive equity returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS does not yield positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases over a 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5% over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates expanding manufacturing activity, which correlates with stronger corporate earnings and positive short-term S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth does not lead to positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances over a 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP growth exceeds 2.0% year-over-year, it signals robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 50% of quarters with GDP growth above 2.0% over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and drives positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive returns in more than 50% of cases over a 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%), the Federal Reserve's policy actions lead to higher discount rates and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5% over a 2-year rolling window.
